publication.publisher_or_container: Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts / Motilal Banarsidass (also Gita Press and other editions)
publication.edition: 16th-century Sanskrit text; Haberman edition and translation; Motilal Banarsidass printings

verification.verification_notes: Work and editions verified via Open Library (Motilal Banarsidass / Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts). Used for the Gaudiya Vaishnava systematization of bhakti as the supreme rasa and for the named, personal object of devotional relish; conceptual claims only.

translation.translator: David L. Haberman (edition/translation); other translations exist
limitations: Sanskrit aesthetic terminology (bhakti-rasa, sthayi-bhava) resists single-word English equivalents; claims concern structure and function, not lexical equivalence.

copyright.notes: 16th-century text; modern editions/translations copyrighted; analytical citation only; no passages reproduced.
